basic_profile.bio: An IT consultant based out of Manchester, UK, who has a deep passion for building custom PCs and gaming. Enjoys exploring the latest in technology and often shares insights and advice on PC builds. Outside of tech, I'm a huge fan of RPG games, particularly the Final Fantasy series, and spend weekends diving into classic titles. Typically online during late evenings after work. Currently in a relationship and often shares tech tips with a significant other who is also a tech enthusiast.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and has been building PCs since teenage years. Extensive self-taught knowledge in overclocking and optimizing PC performance. Regularly reads tech blogs and forums to stay updated on the latest hardware trends.
